sections.content: You know *más … que* and *tan … como* from A2 Unit 6, and relative clauses with *que* and *donde* from B1 Unit 5. Here you use them together: you compare two works, and a relative clause tells the reader which work you mean or adds a fact about it.

items.spanish: La película es más larga que la novela.
items.english: The film is longer than the novel.

items.spanish: Es una obra que presenta una visión muy diferente.
items.english: It is a work that presents a very different view.

items.spanish: La canción tiene un estilo parecido al de la película.
items.english: The song has a style similar to the film's.

items.spanish: La novela, que salió hace muchos años, sigue siendo popular.
items.english: The novel, which came out many years ago, is still popular.

sections.content: A clause with *que* describes the work without a new sentence: *Es una obra que presenta una visión muy diferente.*
